name: Four-cylinder engine kinematics (bench)
notes: Exact-kinematics discriminator: at 600 rpm for 5 s the crank lands on whole revolutions (spool deficit is exactly 5 revs), so piston heights must read exactly 195/105 mm; same for the 1200-rpm leg. Two sequential bench checks on one continuous timeline (no reset between them — intentional). The Math.sin hint is deliberate: Qwen3.5's double-pendulum entry failed grading with bare sin().
